title: A Survey on Post-training of Large Language Models
paper_type_zh: 后训练与大推理模型综述
best_for_zh: 整理微调、对齐、推理、效率与整合适配的后训练综述。
one_line: A 2025 map of post-training that connects data, feedback, reasoning, and system stages before readers enter specialized tracks.
一篇把后训练中的数据、反馈、推理与系统阶段连成概念地图的 2025 综述。
why: It makes the provenance and role of a post-training signal an explicit routing question rather than treating all fine-tuning data alike.
inclusion_reason: A field-level map for readers who need to locate instruction data, preference signals, reasoning traces, verifiers, and evaluation within a post-training pipeline.

title: Problem
问题
html: Post-training is often described by objectives—SFT, preference optimization, RL, or distillation—without a common map of the data objects that connect them. This 2025 arXiv survey is the primary source at https://arxiv.org/abs/2503.06072. It asks how post-training techniques and datasets jointly address capability, alignment, reasoning, efficiency, and adaptation. It establishes a vocabulary for comparing instruction sets, preference pairs, traces, verifiers, and evaluations.
后训练常按 SFT、偏好优化、RL 或蒸馏等目标来讲，却缺少连接这些目标的数据对象地图。这篇 2025 年 arXiv 综述讨论后训练技术与数据集如何共同处理能力、对齐、推理、效率和适配问题。它将指令数据、偏好对、推理轨迹、验证器和评测设置置于同一后训练框架中。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: The survey organizes post-training into five paradigms: fine-tuning, alignment, reasoning, efficiency, and integration/adaptation. Its useful abstraction is not that these are disjoint algorithms, but that they consume and produce different evidence: demonstrations, preference or reward signals, reasoning trajectories, deployment constraints, and evaluations. The official abstract explicitly says it offers a structured taxonomy of techniques and datasets. The closest alternatives are narrower RLHF or reasoning surveys; this Card uses the paper as the broad entrance to the atlas.
综述把后训练组织为五个范式：微调、对齐、推理、效率与集成/适配。其有用之处不在于把它们当作互斥算法，而在于指出它们消费和产出不同证据：示范、偏好或奖励信号、推理轨迹、部署约束和评测。官方摘要明确称其提供了技术与数据集的结构化 分类框架。它不同于只讲 RLHF 或推理的综述，本卡将其定位为图谱入口。

title: Method
方法
html: This is a literature taxonomy rather than a data-construction recipe. It traces post-training evolution and groups methods and datasets by the five paradigms, including reasoning systems described as large reasoning models. When reusing its framework, record the original source for every claimed data object, distinguish model-generated from externally supplied trajectories, and preserve whether a signal is a verifier, a reward, a judge, or an outcome label. The cited papers—not this survey—are the artifacts to inspect for licenses, splits, annotations, and contamination checks.
这是一份文献 分类框架，而不是数据构建配方。它追溯后训练演化，并按五个范式整理方法与数据集，其中包括大推理模型。复用此框架时，应为每个数据对象回链原始来源，区分模型生成轨迹和外部供给轨迹，并保留信号究竟是 验证器、奖励、裁判模型还是 结果 标签。许可证、划分、标注和污染检查应回到被引论文核验，而不能从综述中推断。

title: Evidence
证据
html: The official abstract states that the survey traces post-training across five paradigms and presents a taxonomy of techniques and datasets. It reports 87 pages, 21 figures, and nine tables on its arXiv record. These are scope indicators, not evidence that any individual method or dataset is valid.
官方摘要说明该文覆盖五个后训练范式，并给出技术与数据集 分类框架；arXiv 记录标注为 87 页、21 图、9 表。这些只是覆盖范围的信号，不证明其中任何单项方法或数据集已经通过审计。

title: Novelty
新意
html: The novelty is its broad post-training lens, linking the alignment lineage of early instruction-following systems to contemporary large reasoning models. Fine-tuning, RLHF, and chain-of-thought are not introduced here; the direction signal is their placement in a common data-and-systems map. That framing helps distinguish the objects covered by a generic survey. It should not be treated as a substitute for primary evidence about a particular release.
新意在于用宽广的后训练视角，把早期 指令-following 系统的对齐 脉络 与当代大推理模型连接起来。微调、RLHF 和 CoT 并非由该文首创；方向信号是把它们放入同一张数据与系统地图。这能帮助读者区分泛化综述中的不同对象。它不能取代某个具体发布版本的一手证据。

title: Limitations
局限
html: Taxonomy labels can overlap, especially in multi-stage systems. The survey is a 2025 snapshot and does not itself document the data licenses, splits, or contamination status of every cited work.
分类标签在多阶段系统中可能重叠。该文是 2025 年快照，也不会替每一项被引工作记录数据许可证、划分或污染状态。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: The survey organizes LLM post-training into fine-tuning, alignment, reasoning, efficiency, and integration or adaptation. It describes the techniques and datasets associated with those paradigms, including instruction data, preference signals, rewards, verifiers, and evaluation settings. It does not introduce one shared dataset or post-training recipe.
综述将 LLM 后训练组织为微调、alignment、推理、效率和整合或适配。它描述这些范式涉及的技术和数据集，包括 指令数据、偏好 信号、奖励、验证器与评测设置。论文不提出一个共享数据集或统一的后训练配方。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html: Extract the five-paradigm taxonomy first. For every cited method, ask four audit questions: what is the data object, who produced it, what verifies it, and what evaluation can be contaminated.
后训练并非单一的微调步骤，而是把数据、反馈、推理与系统设计连接起来的一组范式。理解这张概念地图，关键在于看到每种方法使用什么数据、接受什么反馈，并以何种方式改变模型行为。
